name: Dragonborn

traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to the damage type associated with your specific dragon ancestry.

On your turn when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with your Breath Weapon. Targets in the area defined by your dragon ancestry make a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. A failed save deals damage of your dragon ancestry's type; a successful save takes half damage. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus and all expended uses return after a Long Rest.

reviewNotes: 60-foot Darkvision and 30-foot walking speed are selected as the working baseline; both remain subject to the comparative Species balance pass.
Damage type and area shape are supplied by the individual dragon-type Subspecies and/or family definitions; no shape has yet been selected.
Chromatic Warding, Metallic alternative breath effects, and 5.5e temporary flight have not been selected.
No ordinary playable Dragonborn Subspecies is complete until its family and individual traits are approved.
Language and learned dragon traditions belong to separately selected Upbringings. Ability score changes remain deferred.
The C# character mechanics projector does not yet execute this ancestry inheritance and Breath Weapon contract.
